episodes.synopsis: In the nostalgic Kowloon Walled City, Reiko Kujirai is mistaken as her coworker Hajime Kudo's girlfriend.
episodes.title: Episode 1

episodes.synopsis: Reiko tells Yaomay about the photo. Then Reiko meets Miyuki Hebinuma at the free beauty consultation.
episodes.title: Episode 2

episodes.synopsis: Kudo looks for Gwen to no avail. Meanwhile, a masked man tells Reiko she and Kujirai B are different people.
episodes.title: Episode 3

episodes.synopsis: Miyuki Hebinuma investigates Kowloon with Gwen. Meanwhile, Reiko decides to keep living in Kujirai B's room.
episodes.title: Episode 4

episodes.synopsis: Reiko tries to learn more about Kujirai B. Meanwhile, Yaomay acts strange when Reiko mentions the name Yangli.
episodes.title: Episode 5

episodes.synopsis: Gwen tells Reiko and Yaomay that the residents of Kowloon have the second version of themselves.
episodes.title: Episode 6

episodes.synopsis: Miyuki continues to investigate Kowloon and Kurijais situation with Yulongs help. Its a painfull anniversary for Kudo and Kurijai and Yaomay attempt to leave Kowloon.
episodes.title: Episode 7

episodes.synopsis: Reiko learns there are people who can’t see her. Yaomay goes to Hong Kong to investigate.
episodes.title: Episode 8

episodes.synopsis: Yaomay forgets what happened in Hong Kong. Meanwhile, a young man named Xiaohei appears.
episodes.title: Episode 9

episodes.synopsis: Reiko notices that Kujirai B’s glasses show her B’s vision. Then she finds a warning on a talisman.
episodes.title: Episode 10

episodes.synopsis: Reiko takes the boy Xiaohei to meet the girl Xiaohei. Gwen starts to figure out how this Kowloon is created.
episodes.title: Episode 11

episodes.synopsis: Miyuki gives up on his revenge, and Reiko learns the true cause of death of Kujirai B from talking to Yulong.
episodes.title: Episode 12

episodes.synopsis: As reality and fiction, past and present intwetwine, Reiko witnesses Kudo's memory of Kujirai B's death.
episodes.title: Episode 13
